He writes reports on tax policy, labor markets, and economic growth strategies, and his work gets cited by congressional staffers and journalists. He has strong opinions about which economic theories actually work in practice.

messages.output_raw: Need to cancel an online order I placed yesterday for a wireless keyboard.

steps.output_raw:

Need order info and possibly ID. Use tools, but first collect identifying details and whether they want whole order or just keyboard. Keep it short. Then can call find_orders once I have email + zip or order ID. </think>
<plan>

2. Confirm whether they want to cancel the entire order or only the wireless keyboard if other items exist.
3. Use the order tools to check cancellation eligibility and, if possible, process the cancellation.
4. Confirm the result and any refund estimate or timeline.
</plan>
<action type="say">
I can help with that. To look up your order and see what can be canceled, I need a bit more info:

1) Do you have the order ID from the confirmation email? If yes, please paste it here.

   - The shipping ZIP/postal code
   - (Optional but helpful) The last 4 digits of the card you paid with

Also, was the wireless keyboard the only item in the order, or were there other items you want to keep?</action>
